Over the years, Merrell itself has become well known for standout styles like the Moab hiking boot and Jungle Moc, along with its outdoor clothing and accessories (think hats, socks, and small bags). Of note, it’s only valid on full-price items. To sign up, scroll to the footer of the Merrell homepage, enter your email address, and wait for your custom coupon to arrive in your inbox. Your unique coupon code is single-use and can typically be applied to your first purchase of hiking shoes or outdoor apparel, so long as it's a full-priced item.

What to do if a Merrell promo code is not working

Having trouble getting a Merrell promo code to work? There are a few ways to troubleshoot that. First, confirm that your cart meets any minimum purchase thresholds required by the coupon. Then, if applicable, check the exclusion list; many codes do not apply to sale items, new arrivals, or specific collections like the Moab series. Lastly, ensure there are no typos or formatting issues, and verify that the coupon has not expired.
